in_sanskrit.name: नेत्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rūpaṃ ākāraḥ, i.e., Shape, Form or Appearance. Netra is the name of the God of the eyes in Hindu mythology.

in_marathi.name: Netra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Netra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Netra is derived from the Sanskrit word meaning 'eye' or 'vision'. In Hindu mythology, Netra is the name of several deities associated with the divine power of sight and perception. It is also believed that the name bestows upon the child the ability to see the world with clarity and understanding.
